name: IT pause-loop
description: A loop of four items, each of which notes its start in the workspace and then waits until the test puts the file go-<item> there, then one more step: for a pause, a cancel and an interrupt inside the loop.

config.command: echo {{ item }} >> /workspace/ran.txt; n=0; while [ ! -e /workspace/go-{{ item }} ] && [ $n -lt 900 ]; do sleep 0.1; n=$((n + 1)); done; test -e /workspace/go-{{ item }} && echo did {{ item }}
